response: Necrotizing fasciitis is not a clear indication for hyperbaric oxygenation therapy. According to the available data, the results of a study cast doubt on the suggested advantage of hyperbaric oxygen (HBO) in reducing patient mortality and morbidity when used as adjuvant therapy for necrotizing fasciitis. This suggests that the effectiveness of hyperbaric oxygenation therapy in treating necrotizing fasciitis is still uncertain and may not be a recommended course of treatment.
